description: Use this after a specific revenue-loss event already happened and the caller needs the next recovery action. Returns a prioritized decision packet; KlearFlow sends no external message. Execution costs $0.05 via x402 Base USDC.

averageOpportunityValue.description: Estimated gross value in USD of the customer opportunity.

bookingUrl.description: Optional booking URL to include in a recommended recovery message.

businessName.description: Optional business name used to label the recovery packet.

customerFirstName.description: Optional customer first name used only when composing the recommended action text.

eventType.description: Specific revenue-loss event to recover: missed call, stale lead, unanswered quote, appointment no-show, or failed payment.

industry.description: Optional business industry or service category used to tailor the recovery action.

minutesSinceEvent.description: Minutes elapsed since the revenue-loss event occurred.

paymentUrl.description: Optional secure payment-retry URL for payment_failed events.

preferredChannel.description: Preferred recovery channel. Use auto to let KlearFlow select among SMS, email, or a human phone task.

priorAttempts.description: Number of prior recovery outreach attempts already made.

name: recover_revenue

network.description: Payment network identifier, currently Base mainnet eip155:8453.

payer.description: Settled payer address when supplied by the payment facilitator.

priceUsd.description: USDC-denominated execution price settled through x402.

proofId.description: Unique KlearFlow proof identifier for this settled paid execution.

result.description: Recovery decision packet containing priority, recommended action, fallbacks, stop conditions, modeled economics, and safety boundaries.

title: Recover Revenue
